verdict.rationale: The evidence calls x402 an open standard, says it is governed vendor-neutrally under the Linux Foundation, and shows the SDK is published on public npm. None of it names a source repository or an open-source license, and an open protocol spec or a public package is not the same as source under an open license. These are adjacent openness signals, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
